race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: I DONT REALLY CARE matched her previous best despite finding the test inadequate when third over 2m at Cork 18 days ago and, with the return to this sort of trip looking much more suitable, she looks to hold sound claims. That said, Light Up The Dark is surely capable of better than she showed when second on hurdles debut at Galway last month and better is anticipated up in trip. Dinner Dance is another to note on hurdles bow. I DONT REALLY CARE (IRE) LIGHT UP THE DARK DINNER DANCE (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Light Up The Dark (6/4), I Dont Really Care (15/8), Dinner Dance (9/2), Jury Time (10/1), Mystery Decision (14/1), An Lachin Beag (20/1), Filly Butler (20/1), Sea Swirl (25/1), Crios Cu Chulainn (25/1), Rarely Miss Taken (33/1), Park On The Green (50/1), Hadie (50/1), Pat's Prodigies (100/1), Eagle River (150/1), Hello Wee Love (200/1)
